mapper.select: SELECT bbs11_application_id AS application_id, bbs11_app_date AS app_date, bbs11_app_emp_id AS app_emp_id, f_emp_kor_nm(bbs11_app_emp_id) AS app_emp_name, bbs11_app_type AS app_type, f_cdnm('ApplicationType', bbs11_app_type, bbs11_company_id, f_sysdate()) AS app_type_name, bbs11_app_status AS app_status, bbs11_content AS content FROM bbs11_application WHERE bbs11_company_id = #{companyId} AND bbs11_app_type IN ('10', '11', '12') AND bbs11_app_status = #{appStatus} ORDER BY bbs11_app_date DESC, bbs11_app_type
